profile.name: 树莓派GPIO接口
profile.description: 树莓派是一种带有通用输入输出（GPIO）引脚的单板计算机平台，可用于读取数字信号、控制开关量输出、产生PWM信号，并通过SPI连接传感器、模数转换器及其他外设。它常用于实验室自动化、仪器联动、原型开发和远程控制实验装置。
profile.description_en: A Raspberry Pi is a single-board computer platform with general-purpose input/output (GPIO) pins. It can be used to read digital signals, control digital outputs, generate PWM signals, and communicate with sensors, ADCs, and other peripherals over SPI. It is commonly used in laboratory automation, instrument interfacing, prototyping, and remote experiment control.
